# SDLC Orchestrator

Retrieve the supplied Jira story when an authenticated Jira issue-read tool is available; otherwise request pasted story content. Coordinate requirements, architecture, design review, planning, implementation, verification, review, and PR preparation, pausing for required approvals and failed quality gates.
